Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

items.description: Files under the site root, excluding hidden files and blocklisted extensions.

etag.description: An opaque content hash for the file, matching the `ETag` a direct read of the same path returns. Lets a client detect a change — or confirm one it just wrote — without downloading the body, which is why the listing carries it rather than making the caller fetch each file to compare.

path.description: Path relative to the site root.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it back as `cursor`. Absent on the last page — never `null`.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 1000; the responder chooses a default and MAY return fewer.
